            if in_deep:
                mass = sandbox.get_structure_mass()
                required_lift = mass * 9.81 * 0.65  # 65% buoyancy compensation
                fy = min(required_lift, 520.0)

            sandbox.apply_force(b, fx, fy, step_count=step_count)
            b.last_thrust_step = step_count
